Teenager Allegedly Gang-Raped in Delhi Park by Men Posing as Police

A 17-year-old girl was allegedly gang-raped in a Delhi park by three men who posed as police personnel. The incident occurred in Aastha Kunj Park, and has brought the park's security lapses, including a lack of guards and lighting, under scrutiny. The alleged perpetrators were posing as police officers at the time of the incident.
